description: Find games on Cassette that fit what a person wants. Every game comes with facts (devices, players, session length, age rating, download size, whether an account is needed and whether saves follow the player), its store page and a link that opens it. Returns hosted games first, then community games from other sites. An empty result is an answer: tell the person nothing fits.

device.description: The device the person will play on. Games built for it come first.

includeCommunity.description: With a query, also list matching community games from other sites (default true). They are left out when you filter by multiplayer, age or size, which they carry no facts for.

maxAge.description: The highest age rating allowed (0, 7, 12, 16 or 18): the youngest player's age rounded down to one of those.

maxPriceUsd.description: The most they will pay, in US dollars. Free games always pass; 0 means free only.

maxSizeMb.description: The largest download, in megabytes (for slow connections or phones).

multiplayer.description: Only games with a multiplayer mode: any, on one screen (local) or over the internet (online).

query.description: What they are after, in a few plain words: a mood, a kind of game, a name ('relaxing puzzle', 'kart racing', 'factory automation'). Matched against title, tagline, description, tags and genres. Leave it out to list the most played games that pass the filters.

sort.description: relevance (the default with a query) or trending (the default without one), new, or top (most played).

name: search_games
title: Search games
